QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Base Camp
QuestInfo.0: You've spotted a temporary shelter the local hunters use along the way to Abrup.
QuestInfo.1: The hunters' shelter you found on the way to Abrup will make for a perfect temporary shelter for the night once you clear away the snow.
QuestInfo.2:
The temporary shelter you found in the mountains on the way to Abrup is actually pretty cozy once you clear away the snow. It would make a great base camp for traveling back and forth from Abrup.

#bYou can return to Abrup Base Camp through the Dimensional Mirror at any time.#k
